A genuine common interface requires coordinated declaration, lifecycle, virtual-slot and receiver-ABI review. Preserve the eighteen MainInterface event dispatchers and additional ReportIf/InfoWin/StatusWin/Console/turn callers.

payload.hypothesis: MainInterface redraw recovery depends on a real mode stack and borrowed SubInterface registry shared across interface lifecycles. Existing fixed-address aliases and IfaceRegistryEntry casts do not establish the correct common hierarchy; migrate producers, consumers and receiver adjustments together.
